card.name: Space before number of chemo cycles
card.fires_on: The space between "for" (or "up to") and a number of treatment cycles or courses in chemotherapy dosing schedules. The next word is a small digit such as 4, 6 or 8, followed by "cycles".

modes.label: After for, before cycle count
modes.description: The space after "for" at the end of a dosing interval, just before a number of cycles or courses.
modes.example: every 3 weeks for<< >>4 courses administered sequentially to doxorubic

modes.label: After up to
modes.description: The space after "up to" before a maximum cycle count.
modes.example: of a 21-day cycle, up to<< >>8 cycles ( 2.3 )

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward a digit-like count next and away from words like "channels" or "三"; the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a chemotherapy schedule where the number of cycles is about to be given.
